To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we propose a stochastic version of EigenGame that outperforms the original in experiments, and that we analyze the proposed update in the light of the optimization and game perspectives of the eigendecomposition problem.

1) the stochastic update of EigenGame, as proposed in this paper, is unbiased; 2) it enjoys greater parallelism than the original algorithm; and 3) in experiments on principal components analysis and spectral clustering, it outperforms the original algorithm.

(a) we propose an unbiased version of EigenGame that is asymptoticaly equivalent to EigenGame; (b) we show that our proposed update is more efficient than EigenGame; and (c) we discuss how the proposed update is related to EigenGame.
